what: Zero-findings path exits before tally-plan-review.sh runs
scenario_or_breakage: Acceptance and Decision 2 require a per-round header-only findings-classification.tsv but skipped-empty-findings emits only voting-tally.md and never reaches the planned tally invocation
suggested_fix: Either mkdir and write the header-only TSV alongside write_empty_review_artifacts before emit_loop_kvs or invoke tally-plan-review.sh with the empty ballot and new --findings-classification-out; extend test-plan-review-loop expectations accordingly

what: 0-judge voting_result semantics left ambiguous and plan text misaligns with classify_result
scenario_or_breakage: Plan claims main-agent-required disposition from existing tally schema but classify_result for eligible<=0 prints rejected so implementers may pick the wrong literal or confuse analytics
suggested_fix: Specify the exact voting_result string per row for main-agent-required rounds (e.g. empty reserved rejected literal or TALLY status mirror) and if using classify_result document that it yields rejected not main-agent-required

what: Contract sync list not reflected in plan file list

suggested_fix: Add tally-plan-review.md and skills/design/SKILL.md to Files to modify with concrete sections to refresh for the new TSV path and voter line shape

what: New --findings-classification-out flag not covered in usage heredoc

suggested_fix: Extend usage() output alongside the new case branch in getopts parsing

what: TSV emit only plans tab sanitization for reviewer_slots
scenario_or_breakage: Voter-controlled CORRECTNESS SEVERITY QUALITY tokens may embed tabs or newlines breaking column alignment or enabling log injection into committed TSVs
suggested_fix: Define normalization or rejection rules for all vN_* cells sourced from voter files before writing TSV rows

what: Parser exit-0 contract omits malformed vote line case
scenario_or_breakage: When a ballot id line exists but the vote token is not YES NO EXONERATE vote_for_id yields JUDGE_ERROR while it is unclear if parse-judge-vote-and-rating.sh should still exit 0
suggested_fix: Document whether malformed lines yield empty PARSED_VOTE with exit 0 or a hard failure and add a harness case matching that contract

what: Axis value matching described as both verbatim case-preserved and case-insensitive
scenario_or_breakage: Conflicting instructions risk inconsistent implementation and flaky tests
suggested_fix: Choose one normative rule for axis value equality and mirror it in parse-judge-vote-and-rating.md and tests
